No explicit row/column COUNT field and no items-positioning field exist in the schema. No fixture node uses GRID (all three decoded: no stackMode GRID, no grid* field present). Tests build GRID frames by patching fixture frames in the decoded value tree with names, field ids and enum values read from the fixture's schema summary (the builder panics on any name the schema does not declare)
